Label: CountyStatus
Description: Status of a county in terms of rural or urban classification.

Label: Substance
Description: Types of substances that can be abused.

Label: SubstanceRelatedIncident
Description: Types of incidents related to substance abuse.

Label: BRFSS
Description: Variables from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System dataset (year 2022). Topic placement lives on the section-class side under publichealth:/substanceabuse:/settlement:; this class is just the dataset tag.

Label: MEPS
Description: Variables from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey dataset.

Label: NIBRS
Description: Variables from the National Incident-Based Reporting System dataset.

Label: NSDUH
Description: Variables from the National Survey on Drug Use and Health dataset.

Label: corresponding predicate
Description: Links a RuralKG variable to the corresponding FBI NIBRS or NIEM predicate used by interoperable justice knowledge graphs.

Label: city population rank
Description: RuralKG-derived integer population rank of a U.S. city. Attached as an annotation to the GNIS feature IRI for the city. Lower values indicate higher population.
